color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Patient and case context
Patient.identifier/name/birthDate/gender/contact → Patient identity and demographics
Encounter.subject/period → Case membership and dates
Patient.managingOrganization + Encounter.serviceProvider → Center relationship (resolved by references)

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Examination and report context
Procedure.code/subject/encounter/performed[x] → PExamination examination/patient/case/date
DiagnosticReport.code/effective[x]/result → PExamination report context and finding links

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Clinical indication
ServiceRequest.code/reasonCode/reasonReference → PIndication concept and classifications
Referenced Condition or Observation → PIndication clinical reason (terminology and profile dependent)

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Clinical finding
Observation.code/value[x]/component → PFinding and classifications
Condition.code/clinicalStatus → PFinding and status classification
DiagnosticReport.result → PExamination-to-finding links (reference resolution)

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Finding-related intervention
Procedure.code/bodySite/reasonReference → Intervention concept and finding relation (primary performed-action context)
MedicationAdministration.medication[x]/effective[x] → Medication detail (only when medication was administered)
Procedure.focalDevice/usedReference + Device → Device detail (only when a device is clinically relevant)
DiagnosticReport.specimen + Specimen → Specimen context (only for sampling interventions)

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Performer and center context
Procedure.performer.actor → Examiner relation (reference resolution)
Practitioner + PractitionerRole → Examiner identity and role
PractitionerRole.organization + Organization → Center
